title: Sky's the Limit Sequential TDD Execution Program
instruction: Execute only the audited dependency-safe sequence; keep PR 169 draft and stop before production approval.

purpose: Anti-regression baseline. This is telemetry, not a billing statement. Audited compiler adds semantic DAG, rank, cursor, and gate validation.
Owns sequence, locks, ledgers, gates, and stop conditions.
Only agent allowed to modify implementation or test code.
Uses Graphify, Context7, repository reads, and provider reads within bounded scope.
Confirms red failure reason and green pass without weakening tests.
Reviews diff, acceptance evidence, maintainability, and regression risk.
Required for high-risk auth, data, payment, file, migration, and production-boundary nodes.
Compares actual telemetry and provider spend with node budgets.
Commits, pushes, and updates the one draft PR only after code writer releases the mutex.
Approves major gates; approval cannot be inferred or auto-recorded.

name: one_writer
text: Exactly one mutation-capable agent may hold the global writer mutex.

name: sequential_nodes
text: Only one execution-sequence node may be active at a time.

name: main_checkout_read_only
text: Never implement in the main checkout; use the governed integration worktree.

name: clean_worktree_entry
text: Each node starts from a clean integration worktree and verified HEAD.

name: red_before_code
text: Write the focused regression or contract test before implementation code.

name: prove_red
text: Run the new test and prove it fails for the intended missing behavior, not environment damage.

name: no_code_before_red
text: Implementation is blocked until red evidence is recorded.

name: smallest_correct_change
text: Implement the smallest production change that satisfies the red contract.

name: prove_green
text: Run the same test and prove it passes after implementation.

name: test_integrity
text: Do not delete, skip, weaken, invert, or overmock the red test to obtain green.

name: focused_then_broad
text: Run focused tests first; run scoped quality checks next; full gate checks only at node/batch boundaries.

name: max_two_attempts
text: After two failed implementation attempts for the same root cause, stop and create a diagnostic/replan task.

name: independent_review
text: Every node receives read-only review; high-risk nodes also require security review.

name: one_draft_pr
text: Open one draft PR after B25 and update it; do not create a PR per task node.

name: issue_policy
text: Create GitHub issues only for out-of-scope defects, security findings, deferred production work, or repeated failures.

name: commit_per_node
text: Each completed implementation node gets a focused conventional commit.

name: push_after_review
text: Push only after green tests, cost gate, and independent review pass.

name: no_auto_approval
text: Permission to work is not approval that a gate passed.

name: provider_preflight
text: Verify account, team, resource, environment, and operation class before OAuth or provider access.

name: secret_safety
text: Never persist tokens, cookies, secret values, private keys, raw PII, or low-entropy secret hashes.

name: context_budget
text: Graphify query first, start with at most three source files, and never bulk-load generated graph reports.

name: artifact_logs
text: Store complete logs as artifacts; provide only bounded summaries to model context.

name: design_governance
text: Every UI node must use DESIGN.md, page spec, wireframe, UI UX Pro Max, Impeccable, anti-slop, and required evidence.

name: production_stop
text: Stop before G70 and before production data, schema, deployment, domain, payment, communication, GBP, dual-write, transfer, deletion, or cutover.

name: cost_replan
text: Replan when actual cost exceeds expected by more than 50 percent or warning thresholds are reached.

name: wait_bound
text: Do not poll indefinitely; every wait has timeout, max attempts, and a state-change condition.

name: external_cache
text: Vendor repositories and nested Git metadata stay outside the product repository.

name: safe_cleanup
text: Remove ephemeral worktrees, secret scratch, and temporary clones only after evidence and recovery checks.

name: compiled_dag
text: The executable stage graph must be acyclic; schema validity alone is insufficient.

name: topological_rank
text: Every sequential rank must respect all explicit and synthetic dependencies.

name: review_findings_block_merge
text: Any unresolved P0, P1, or P2 security or architecture finding keeps the PR draft and blocks merge.

name: exact_head_preview
text: The exact reviewed head must have a successful Vercel Preview before the PR can be marked ready.
